visual_summary: A bearded, balding man in a blue uniform forcibly embraces a dark-haired young woman inside what looks like a ship or metallic chamber. He declares his desire to marry her while she recoils in shock. An older white-haired, white-bearded man intervenes, grabs or chokes the suitor to stop him, and orders him to release her. The young woman pleads for the older man not to kill the attacker. The bearded suitor then calls for guards as the woman kneels nearby.
